d:
Jharkhand Assembly Special Session : jharkhand vidhanasbha apne 26ven sthapna divas ke mauke par bhavy samaroh ke lie taiyar hai. sthapna divas ko lekar vidhanasbha bhavan ko aakarshak tarike se sajaya gaya hai. pure vidhanasbha parisar men khas taiyariyan ki gaee hain. jharkhand vidhanasbha ke 26 sal ke gauravshali saphar ko yadgar banane ke lie samaroh ka aayojan kiya ja raha hai. dekhie sthapna divas ki khas taiyari aur saji huee vidhanasbha bhavan ki tasviren.
